title: Issues with game refunds and completion when `Staking` contract is changed
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  In the `Flip` contract, the `setStakingContract()` function allows the contract owner to change the staking contract address. However, changing the staking contract while there are pending games will result in those pending games being left incomplete.
